dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, jagged 'O' and 'C' shaped structures distributed across the dorsal-central region; perimeters consist of thin, high-contrast dark lines with internal gradients transitioning to lighter grey interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Highly concentrated, asymmetrical cluster of high-intensity white pixels located in the lower-right quadrant; exhibits a dense core with a rapid intensity fall-off at the edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A complex polygon formed by the centroids of four prominent mid-dorsal annuli and the primary high-intensity blob in the posterior region; the relationship is characterized by obtuse internal angles.

other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-luminance white patch located in the lower-right quadrant that significantly exceeds the local intensity range of the surrounding pelt pattern.
